q: Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of injustice, to undo the thongs of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and to break every yoke? Is it not to share your bread with the hungry, and bring the homeless poor into your house; when you see the naked, to cover them, and not to hide yourself from your own kin?
How does God's love abide in anyone who has the world's goods and sees a brother or sister in need and yet refuses help?
points.apply: Keep a box for what you save by fasting, and give it to the poor at Easter.

q: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and put a new and right spirit within me.

You were taught to put away your former way of life, your old self, corrupt and deluded by its lusts, and to be renewed in the spirit of your minds, and to clothe yourselves with the new self, created according to the likeness of God in true righteousness and holiness.
points.apply: Name one habit of the old self to put away during these fifty days.

concl: The Great Fast is time with God, a fast of justice and sharing, and a change of clothes.
In Christ who overcame the tempter, we too can overcome.
2027-02-07.resolve: Be reconciled tonight at Pethurtha, and begin the fast tomorrow with prayer, fasting and almsgiving.

intro: Theme: “Everyone then who hears these words of mine and acts on them will be like a wise man who built his house on rock.”
Enoch who walked with God, the stones of the Jordan, the free gift of God, and the house built on rock.

q: Enoch walked with God; then he was no more, because God took him.
By faith Enoch was taken so that he did not experience death; and “he was not found, because God had taken him.” For it was attested before he was taken away that “he had pleased God.”
points.apply: Spend fifteen minutes each day this week walking with God in prayer.

sub: Our Lenten customs tell Christ's story.
q: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the LORD is mighty, and so that you may fear the LORD your God forever.”
like living stones, let yourselves be built into a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
points.apply: Explain to a child this week the meaning of one Lenten custom of your family.

sub: Slaves of sin or of God.
The free gift of eternal life.
q: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Choose life so that you and your descendants may live,
For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
points.apply: Make your Lenten confession before the third Sunday of the Great Fast.

sub: Not everyone who says Lord, Lord.
The same storm for both houses.
Digging while the sky is clear.
q: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, my God, my rock in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
“Everyone then who hears these words of mine and acts on them will be like a wise man who built his house on rock.
points.apply: Choose one word of the Sermon on the Mount and live it daily this week.

concl: The Great Fast is not a list of things given up but a walk with God, remembered and handed on.
Choose the gift, do the word, and build on the rock while the sky is clear.
2027-02-14.resolve: Put one teaching of Jesus into practice every day this week, and explain the meaning of the fast to a child.

intro: Theme: “just as the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.”
The ark shut by God, the bare feet of Joshua, the cry of Paul, and the cup of the Servant.

q: And those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him; and the LORD shut him in.

For as in those days before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark, and they knew nothing until the flood came and swept them all away, so too will be the coming of the Son of Man.
points.apply: Do not miss Sunday Holy Qurbana for the rest of the Great Fast.

sub: Are you for us or for our adversaries?
q: The commander of the army of the LORD said to Joshua, “Remove the sandals from your feet, for the place where you stand is holy.” And Joshua did so.
By faith the walls of Jericho fell after they had been encircled for seven days.
points.apply: Pray every day for seven days about the habit of sin that has resisted you longest.

sub: I do not do what I want.
Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ.
q: I waited patiently for the LORD; he inclined to me and heard my cry. He drew me up from the desolate pit, out of the miry bog, and set my feet upon a rock, making my steps secure.
Wretched man that I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death? Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord!
points.apply: Bring your struggle honestly to the sacrament of reconciliation this Lent.

points.h: To serve and to give his life
sub: The third announcement of the Passion.
Are you able to drink my cup?
q: Out of his anguish he shall see light; he shall find satisfaction through his knowledge. The righteous one, my servant, shall make many righteous, and he shall bear their iniquities.
just as the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.”
points.apply: Take on one humble task this week that usually falls to someone else.

concl: We are saved inside the ark, by the Lord who shuts the door and carries us above the flood.
Bow before you fight, cry to the One who rescues, and choose to serve.
2027-02-21.resolve: Stay faithful to Sunday Holy Qurbana, pray for seven days against one habit of sin, and take the lowest task at home this week.

intro: Theme: “The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; this was the Lord's doing, and it is amazing in our eyes.”
Babel and Pentecost, the hidden sin in the tent, the Spirit of adoption, and the rejected Son who became the cornerstone.

points.h: Let us make a name for ourselves
sub: A tower with its top in the heavens.
The LORD came down to see it.
q: Then they said, “Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower with its top in the heavens, and let us make a name for ourselves; otherwise we shall be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.”
And at this sound the crowd gathered and was bewildered, because each one heard them speaking in the native language of each.
points.apply: Do one good work this week for God's name alone, and tell no one.

sub: One hidden sin weakens the camp.
q: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed my covenant that I imposed on them. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have acted deceitfully, and they have put them among their own belongings.
If we confess our sins, he who is faithful and just will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
points.apply: Make a thorough confession before Palm Sunday, and return anything taken unjustly.

sub: Suffering with him, glorified with him.
q: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
For all who are led by the Spirit of God are children of God.
points.apply: Pray the Lord's Prayer slowly every evening this week, as a child speaking to the Father.

sub: The son thrown out and killed.
q: The stone that the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone. This is the LORD's doing; it is marvelous in our eyes.
Therefore I tell you, the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people that produces the fruits of the kingdom.
points.apply: Offer one concrete fruit to your parish before Easter.

concl: The name we make for ourselves scatters us; the Son whom the world rejected gathers us and holds everything together.
Search the tent, cry Abba as children, and give the Lord of the vineyard his fruit.
2027-02-28.resolve: This week, do one hidden good work, make a careful examination of conscience, and pray the Our Father slowly each evening.

intro: Theme: “But the Lord is faithful.”
The faithful Lord, the woman who reached out, and the girl raised by the hand.

q: The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases, his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
points.apply: Thank God each morning this week for one sign of his faithfulness.

points.h: If I only touch his cloak
q: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all his benefits— who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases,
Jesus turned, and seeing her he said, “Take heart, daughter; your faith has made you well.” And instantly the woman was made well.
points.apply: Bring one long-standing trouble to Jesus in prayer today.

sub: He takes her by the hand.
q: Your dead shall live, their corpses shall rise. O dwellers in the dust, awake and sing for joy!
But when the crowd had been put outside, he went in and took her by the hand, and the girl got up.
points.apply: Pray for a family that has lost a child or a young person.

concl: Our faith may be small, but the Lord is faithful.
Reach out and touch him; he turns, and he raises up.
2027-02-01.resolve: Each day this week, make one short act of trust in the Lord's faithfulness.

intro: Theme: “My food is to do the will of him who sent me.”
The apostle's last charge, the woman who left her water jar, and the harvest that others sowed.

points.h: My food is to do his will
sub: Food you do not know about.
q: I delight to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart.
Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to complete his work.
points.apply: Begin today by asking: Father, what is your will for me today?

q: May those who sow in tears reap with shouts of joy.
Do you not say, ‘Four months more, then comes the harvest’? But I tell you, look around you, and see how the fields are ripe for harvesting.
points.apply: Invite one person who has drifted away to come with you to the Holy Qurbana.

sub: In season and out of season.
q: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the messenger who announces peace, who brings good news, who announces salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns.”
proclaim the message; be persistent whether the time is favorable or unfavorable; convince, rebuke, and encourage, with the utmost patience in teaching.
points.apply: Speak a word of faith this week where you would usually stay silent.

concl: Christ is fed by the Father's will, and he feeds us so that we may do it too.
Leave your water jar, look at the fields, and proclaim him.
2027-02-03.resolve: Thank and pray for those who first taught you the faith, and share it with one person this week.

intro: Theme: “Forgive, and you will be forgiven.”
God's patience, the log in our own eye, and the martyr who became all things to all people.

q: Forgive your neighbor the wrong he has done, and then your sins will be pardoned when you pray.
Do not judge, and you will not be judged; do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven;
points.apply: Forgive one person today, in your heart and, if possible, in words.

points.h: The log in my own eye
q: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your neighbor's eye.
points.apply: Make a careful examination of conscience tonight before you sleep.

sub: A Portuguese courtier turned Tamil ascetic.
q: I will give you as a light to the nations, that my salvation may reach to the end of the earth.
To the weak I became weak, so that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all people, that I might by all means save some.
points.apply: Learn a greeting or a prayer in the language of a neighbour or co-worker.

concl: God's patience with us is the measure of our patience with others.
Take out your own log, and love others as the saints did, in good measure.
2027-02-04.resolve: Go one day this week without criticizing anyone, and pray for missionaries.

intro: Theme: “It is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory.”
The valley of dry bones, the resurrection of the body, and the mercy of praying for the dead.

q: He said to me, “Mortal, can these bones live?” I answered, “O Lord GOD, you know.”
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Those who believe in me, even though they die, will live,
points.apply: Bring to God one area of your life that feels dry and dead.

sub: Like a seed in the earth.
The man of dust and the man of heaven.
q: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
So it is with the resurrection of the dead. What is sown is perishable, what is raised is imperishable. It is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness, it is raised in power.
points.apply: Visit the cemetery this week and pray with hope at the graves.

q: But if he was looking to the splendid reward that is laid up for those who fall asleep in godliness, it was a holy and pious thought. Therefore he made atonement for the dead, so that they might be delivered from their sin.
And the king will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, just as you did it to one of the least of these who are members of my family, you did it to me.’
points.apply: Have a Holy Qurbana offered for your departed, and give an alms in their name.

concl: God has forgotten none of our dead; he will raise them in glory.
Pray for them, serve Christ in the least, and enter the Great Fast in hope.
2027-02-05.resolve: Make a list of your departed family members and pray for them every day of the Great Fast.

intro: Theme: “I am standing at the door, knocking.”
The lukewarm church, the Lord who knocks, and the crowds who laid their poverty at his feet.

q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
I know your works; you are neither cold nor hot. I wish that you were either cold or hot.
points.apply: Name one area where you have grown lukewarm, and choose one act of fervour for the Great Fast.

sub: He does not break the door.
He wants to eat with us.
q: I slept, but my heart was awake. Listen! my beloved is knocking. “Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my perfect one;
Listen! I am standing at the door, knocking; if you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to you and eat with you, and you with me.
points.apply: Open the door with a good confession before or early in the Great Fast.

sub: The lame, the blind, the mute.
They praised the God of Israel.
q: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf unstopped; then the lame shall leap like a deer, and the tongue of the speechless sing for joy.
Great crowds came to him, bringing with them the lame, the maimed, the blind, the mute, and many others. They put them at his feet, and he cured them,
points.apply: Bring a sick or disabled person to Jesus in prayer, and visit them this week.

concl: Christ knocks at the door of every lukewarm heart.
Admit your poverty, open the door, and let him carry you into the Great Fast.
2027-02-06.resolve: Begin the Great Fast with a good confession and one concrete act of fervour.

intro: Theme: “first be reconciled to your brother or sister, and then come and offer your gift.”
The ash of the Vibhoodi, the first light of creation, Joshua's courage, and the peace Jesus asks before the altar.

q: By the sweat of your face you shall eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken; you are dust, and to dust you shall return.
For he says, “At an acceptable time I have listened to you, and on a day of salvation I have helped you.” See, now is the acceptable time; see, now is the day of salvation!
points.apply: Write down today what you will fast from, and keep the note in your Bible.

sub: God saw that it was good.
q: Then God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light.
So if anyone is in Christ, there is a new creation: everything old has passed away; see, everything has become new!
points.apply: Ask God each morning of this week to speak his light into one dark corner of your life.

sub: The gift left at the altar.
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
leave your gift there before the altar and go; first be reconciled to your brother or sister, and then come and offer your gift.
points.apply: Take the first step towards one estranged person before Sunday.

concl: The Great Fast begins with ash and with light: we are dust, and God speaks over us again.
Be strong and courageous, and let the first fruit of the fast be peace.
2027-02-08.resolve: Make peace with one person before receiving Holy Qurbana on Sunday.

intro: Theme: “God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance.”
Dust that carries God's breath, the patience of God, and the generosity of the second mile.

sub: Renewed in the image of the Creator.
q: then the Lord God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and the man became a living being.
and have clothed yourselves with the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge according to the image of its creator.
points.apply: Thank God today for your body and your life, and offer both to him in the fast.

q: rend your hearts and not your clothing. Return to the LORD, your God, for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love, and relents from punishing.
Or do you despise the riches of his kindness and forbearance and patience? Do you not realize that God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?
points.apply: Replace one judgment of another person with a prayer for them.

sub: Not an eye for an eye.
What the fast saves, the poor receive.
q: You shall not take vengeance or bear a grudge against any of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the LORD.
and if anyone forces you to go one mile, go also the second mile.
points.apply: Give away this week what your fast has saved.

concl: We are dust, but dust that carries God's breath, and God's kindness calls us home.
Let that kindness flow through us, one second mile at a time.
2027-02-09.resolve: Keep a box for the poor at home through the whole Great Fast.

intro: Theme: “Your Father who sees in secret will reward you.”
The gift of companionship, Rahab's faith, and the inner room of prayer.

q: Therefore a man leaves his father and his mother and clings to his wife, and they become one flesh.
So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.
points.apply: Plan with your family one shared Lenten practice and keep it until Easter.

points.h: A crimson cord in the window
q: She said, “According to your words, so be it.” She sent them away and they departed. Then she tied the crimson cord in the window.
By faith Rahab the prostitute did not perish with those who were disobedient, because she had received the spies in peace.
points.apply: Put into practice today one word of Scripture you already know well.

q: O LORD, you have searched me and known me.
But whenever you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
points.apply: Make a quiet prayer corner at home this week.

concl: God made us for communion: with one another, and above all with him.
Keep the fast together, live the word you hear, and meet the Father in secret.
2027-02-10.resolve: Pray ten minutes in silence every day of this week.

intro: Theme: “But strive first for the kingdom of God and his righteousness.”
God's question in the garden, the ark that goes ahead into the river, and the trust that fasting teaches.

q: But the Lord God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
For the Son of Man came to seek out and to save the lost.
points.apply: Make a careful examination of conscience tonight and plan your Lenten confession.

q: Then Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
Pursue peace with everyone, and the holiness without which no one will see the Lord.
points.apply: Choose one habit to give up this Lent as preparation for what God will do.

q: Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never permit the righteous to be moved.
But strive first for the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.
points.apply: Each morning this week, name one worry and hand it to God before you begin work.

concl: God calls us out of hiding and goes ahead of us into the river.
Let the fast teach us to trust: the Father knows what we need.
2027-02-11.resolve: Go to confession during the first weeks of the Great Fast.

intro: Theme: “Where is your brother Abel?”
Cain's question, Abraham's hope, the stones of the Jordan, and the eye that judges.

sub: A better word from the Cross.
q: Then the Lord said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” He said, “I do not know; am I my brother's keeper?”
Those who say, “I love God,” and hate their brothers or sisters, are liars; for those who do not love a brother or sister whom they have seen, cannot love God whom they have not seen.
points.apply: Do one concrete thing this week for a brother, sister or neighbour in need.

sub: A body as good as dead.
q: And he believed the LORD; and the LORD reckoned it to him as righteousness.
Hoping against hope, he believed that he would become “the father of many nations,” according to what was said, “So numerous shall your descendants be.”
points.apply: Bring one hopeless situation to God every day of this week.

q: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is ever before me.
You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your neighbor's eye.
points.apply: Each time you are tempted to criticise someone today, name one of your own faults instead.

concl: God asks where our brother is, and the Cross answers with mercy.
Keep your brother, hope against hope, and let Christ heal your eyes.
2027-02-12.resolve: Walk the Way of the Cross on every Friday of the Great Fast.

intro: Theme: “And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.”
Grace given freely, the prayer Christ taught, and the forgiveness that the forgiven must give.

q: Ho, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; and you that have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
they are now justified by his grace as a gift, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
points.apply: Thank God today for one grace you know you did not earn.

sub: Daily bread for those who fast.
Rescue in the time of trial.
q: Yet, O LORD, you are our Father; we are the clay, and you are our potter; we are all the work of your hand.
“Pray then in this way: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.
points.apply: Pray the Our Father slowly each night of the coming week.

q: Forgive your neighbor the wrong he has done, and then your sins will be pardoned when you pray.
For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you;
points.apply: Forgive one person by name before receiving Holy Qurbana tomorrow.

concl: The fast begins and ends in grace: God gives first, and we answer with gratitude.
Pray as Jesus taught, and forgive as you have been forgiven.
2027-02-13.resolve: Pray the Our Father slowly with your family every night until Easter.

intro: Theme: “there is nothing outside a person that by going in can defile, but the things that come out are what defile.”
Why we fast from clean food, what really defiles, and the mercy that washes the heart.

sub: The old Great Fast of our elders.
q: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and put a new and right spirit within me.
there is nothing outside a person that by going in can defile, but the things that come out are what defile.
points.apply: Tell God in prayer today what your fast is meant to change in your heart.

q: Keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life.
For it is from within, from the human heart, that evil intentions come
points.apply: Make a short examination of conscience each night this week.

q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
he saved us, not because of any works of righteousness that we had done, but according to his mercy, through the water of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
points.apply: Speak evil of no one for the rest of this week.

concl: We fast from clean things so that the heart may become clean.
What we cannot scrub away, God washes by his mercy and renews by his Spirit.
2027-02-15.resolve: Keep a fast of the tongue this week: no slander, no gossip, no harsh word at home.

intro: Theme: “Ask, and it will be given you; search, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened for you.”
The groaning of creation, the patience of hope, and the Father who gives good things to those who ask.

sub: A birth pang, not a death rattle.
q: For I am about to create new heavens and a new earth; the former things shall not be remembered or come to mind.
We know that the whole creation has been groaning in labor pains until now;
points.apply: Do one concrete thing this week to care for God's creation, especially water.

sub: Hope that is seen is not hope.
q: but those who wait for the LORD shall renew their strength, they shall mount up with wings like eagles, they shall run and not be weary, they shall walk and not faint.
For in hope we were saved. Now hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for what is seen? But if we hope for what we do not see, we wait for it with patience.
points.apply: When the fast feels hard, offer that moment to God as an act of hope.

sub: Not a machine but a Father.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
q: When you search for me, you will find me; if you seek me with all your heart,
“Ask, and it will be given you; search, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened for you.
points.apply: Choose one intention and keep asking for it every day until Easter.

concl: Creation groans and we groan with it, but it is the groan of a birth.
Ask the Father with confidence, and do to others as you would have them do to you.
2027-02-16.resolve: Pray every day until Easter for one intention, and do one unasked kindness each day this week.

intro: Theme: “Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.”
Friends who carry, the deepest healing, the authority to forgive given to human beings, and members offered for holiness.

sub: A man who could not come by himself.
Some walk, some are carried, some carry.
q: But Moses' hands grew weary; so they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side, and the other on the other side; so his hands were steady until the sun set.
Bear one another's burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
points.apply: Help one sick or elderly person to receive the sacraments this Lent.

q: Come now, let us argue it out, says the LORD: though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be like snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven.”
points.apply: Fix the day of your Lenten confession.

q: as far as the east is from the west, so far he removes our transgressions from us.
If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained.
points.apply: Pray this week for the priests who will hear confessions in your parish.

concl: Jesus sees the faith of those who carry, and he heals the deepest paralysis first.
The authority to forgive is in the Church; let us go, and let us bring others.
2027-02-17.resolve: Make your Lenten confession, and help one other person to make theirs.

intro: Theme: “Let your word be ‘Yes, Yes’ or ‘No, No’; anything more than this comes from the evil one.”
God's faithfulness, the rule that we may not do evil for good to come, and the simple truthful word.

q: The steadfast love of the LORD never ceases, his mercies never come to an end; they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
What if some were unfaithful? Will their faithlessness nullify the faithfulness of God? By no means!
points.apply: Thank God each morning this week for one promise he has kept to you.

points.h: Not evil that good may come
sub: The lie, the bribe, the account.
Mercy is a door out of sin.
q: Ah, you who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter!
Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
points.apply: Correct one small dishonesty in your work or accounts this Lent.

sub: A word that needs no support.
q: O LORD, who may abide in your tent? Who may dwell on your holy hill? Those who walk blamelessly, and do what is right, and speak the truth from their heart;
Let your word be ‘Yes, Yes’ or ‘No, No’; anything more than this comes from the evil one.
points.apply: Go through this week without a single oath in your ordinary speech.

concl: God's yes never fails, even when our promises do.
Let us become people whose plain word is enough.
2027-02-18.resolve: Keep one neglected promise, and speak without oaths for the rest of the Great Fast.

intro: Theme: “Today I have rolled away from you the disgrace of Egypt.”
The grief of God over sin, the new beginning at Gilgal, the holy law, and the evasion that refuses to change.

points.h: It grieved him to his heart
q: And the LORD was sorry that he had made humankind on the earth, and it grieved him to his heart.
And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, with which you were marked with a seal for the day of redemption.
points.apply: Make the Way of the Cross today and offer the Lord your sorrow for having grieved him.

q: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away from you the disgrace of Egypt.” And so that place is called Gilgal to this day.
Clean out the old yeast so that you may be a new batch, as you really are unleavened. For our paschal lamb, Christ, has been sacrificed.
points.apply: Bring one old disgrace to the Lord in confession this Lent.

q: O that today you would listen to his voice! Do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness,
If you continue in my word, you are truly my disciples; and you will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.
points.apply: In your next confession, name plainly what you already know.

concl: Sin grieves the heart of God, and the Cross shows how deeply he loves us still.
Stop calculating; let the Lord roll away your disgrace.
2027-02-19.resolve: Make the Way of the Cross today and go to confession before the end of next week.

intro: Theme: “Yet wisdom is vindicated by her deeds.”
Children who will neither dance nor mourn, the seasons of fast and feast, and the self-examination the Church asks of her members.

sub: A heart that will not respond.
q: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we wailed, and you did not mourn.’
points.apply: Keep the rest of this fast with real sorrow for sin, so that you may keep Easter with real joy.

q: Let us test and examine our ways, and return to the LORD.
But if we judged ourselves, we would not be judged.
points.apply: Make a careful examination of conscience this evening.

sub: Do not argue with the mockers.
q: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One is insight.
Who is wise and understanding among you? Show by your good life that your works are done with gentleness born of wisdom.
points.apply: Answer mockery with a good deed this week.

concl: The problem is never God's music, but a heart that will not respond.
Judge yourself first, and let your deeds speak.
2027-02-20.resolve: Give up one enslaving habit until Easter, and make an honest examination of conscience tonight.

intro: Theme: “you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.”
The new life of the Spirit, the two great commandments, and the scribe who was not far from the kingdom.

q: Hear, O Israel: The LORD is our God, the LORD alone. You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.
you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.
points.apply: Say the first commandment each morning this week before you speak to anyone.

points.h: The new life of the Spirit
sub: Dead to the law through the body of Christ.
Fruit for death, fruit for God.
A fast kept with a new heart.
q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
But now we are discharged from the law, dead to that which held us captive, so that we are slaves not under the old written code but in the new life of the Spirit.
points.apply: Choose one Lenten practice you keep grudgingly, and offer it today as a gift of love.

q: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” After that no one dared to ask him any question.
points.apply: Take the step you have been postponing: confession, reconciliation, or a return to Sunday Qurbana.

concl: The fast is not a ledger of rules but a heart set free to love.
Love God with everything, love your neighbour as yourself, and do not stay at the door.
2027-02-22.resolve: Let one decision each day this week be made by the first commandment.

intro: Theme: “So if you think you are standing, watch out that you do not fall.”
Israel in the desert as a lesson for us, the faithfulness of God in temptation, and the watchfulness Jesus asks.

sub: Under the cloud and through the sea.
q: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. O that today you would listen to his voice! Do not harden your hearts, as at Meribah, as on the day at Massah in the wilderness,
These things happened to them to serve as an example, and they were written down to instruct us, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
points.apply: Notice when you grumble today, and turn each complaint into a short prayer.

q: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you; when you walk through fire you shall not be burned, and the flame shall not consume you.

No testing has overtaken you that is not common to everyone. God is faithful, and he will not let you be tested beyond your strength, but with the testing he will also provide the way out so that you may be able to endure it.
points.apply: Decide now what your way out will be when your usual temptation comes.

q: my soul waits for the LORD more than those who watch for the morning, more than those who watch for the morning.
Be alert at all times, praying that you may have the strength to escape all these things that will take place, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
points.apply: Keep the fifty days free of alcohol, or of whatever most weighs your heart down.

concl: The baptised are not safe because they once crossed the water, but because they keep watching.
God is faithful: watch, pray, and take the way out he provides.
2027-02-23.resolve: Name your heaviest burden of pleasure, drink or worry, and give it up for the rest of the Great Fast.

intro: Theme: “But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.”
The blessing that breaks the circle of evil, peace that must be pursued, and the whole love of the Father.

sub: A tender heart and a humble mind.
q: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
Do not repay evil for evil or abuse for abuse; but, on the contrary, repay with a blessing.
points.apply: Answer the next insult with a blessing, or with silence and a prayer.

sub: You have heard that it was said.
Bread and water for the enemy.
q: If your enemies are hungry, give them bread to eat; and if they are thirsty, give them water to drink;
But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
points.apply: Pray by name each evening until Easter for one person who has hurt you.

sub: What more are you doing than others?
A love with no one left out.
q: Speak to all the congregation of the people of Israel and say to them: You shall be holy, for I the LORD your God am holy.
Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
points.apply: Do one quiet kindness this week for someone who does not like you.

concl: Christian love begins where the return stops.
Bless, pray, and let your love fall like the rain, on everyone.
2027-02-24.resolve: Choose one name and pray for that person every day until Easter.

intro: Theme: “Render service with enthusiasm, as to the Lord.”
Service offered to Christ, the warning against religion for show, and Blessed Rani Maria, a treasure in a clay jar.

q: Honor your father and your mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
Render service with enthusiasm, as to the Lord and not to men and women,
points.apply: Offer your work to Christ each morning this week before you begin it.

q: learn to do good; seek justice, rescue the oppressed, defend the orphan, plead for the widow.
They devour widows' houses and for the sake of appearance say long prayers. They will receive the greater condemnation.
points.apply: Support one effort that frees the poor from debt or exploitation.

q: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his faithful ones.
But we have this treasure in clay jars, so that it may be made clear that this extraordinary power belongs to God and does not come from us.
points.apply: Forgive one person this week, and pray for them as Rani Maria's family prayed.

concl: Service offered to the Lord needs no long robes and no best seats.
Blessed Rani Maria served the poor to the end, and her family's forgiveness showed the power of God in clay jars.
2027-02-25.resolve: Do one hidden service for the poor this week, through the prayers of Blessed Rani Maria.

intro: Theme: “There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.”
The rainbow covenant, the patient obedience that brought down Jericho, freedom from condemnation, and the God of the living.

sub: A weapon hung in the sky.
q: I have set my bow in the clouds, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
And he did the same with the cup after supper, saying, “This cup that is poured out for you is the new covenant in my blood.
points.apply: Thank God tonight for three promises he has kept in your life.

sub: The law of the Spirit of life.
The mind set on the Spirit.
q: Come now, let us argue it out, says the LORD: though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be like snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
points.apply: If an old sin still weighs on you after confession, hand it to Christ today and believe his pardon.

sub: Our dead are alive to him.
q: He said further, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” And Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
He is God not of the dead, but of the living; you are quite wrong.”
points.apply: Pray for your departed by name today, and visit a grave if you can.

concl: God remembers his covenant, and in Christ there is no condemnation.
Walk patiently like Israel around Jericho, and remember that the road of the Cross leads to the God of the living.
2027-02-26.resolve: Pray the Way of the Cross today, and end it with a prayer for your departed.

intro: Theme: “be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ has forgiven you.”
Truth and anger among members of one body, words that give grace, and the son who changed his mind.

sub: Do not make room for the devil.
q: A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
Be angry but do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger,
points.apply: End no day this week without settling the day's quarrels.

q: Set a guard over my mouth, O LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.
Let no evil talk come out of your mouths, but only what is useful for building up, as there is need, so that your words may give grace to those who hear.
points.apply: Say one word of encouragement to each member of your family today.

points.h: He changed his mind and went
sub: I go, sir, and did not go.
q: Again, when the wicked turn away from the wickedness they have committed and do what is lawful and right, they shall save their life.

For John came to you in the way of righteousness and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him; and even after you saw it, you did not change your minds and believe him.
points.apply: Do today what you promised God and have not yet done.

concl: We are members of one another: let the sun never set on our anger, and let our words give grace.
A yes without going is empty; a no can still become a yes. Now is the time to go into the vineyard.
2027-02-27.resolve: Make your Lenten confession, if you have not yet made it, before the Fourth Sunday of the Great Fast.
